explication: This repository packages and runs vLLM optimized for DGX Spark, from a single host or a multi-node cluster. The primary workflow is to select a YAML recipe, optionally prepare an image and download model weights, then launch a configured vLLM server; cluster setup also supports topology discovery and distributed execution. Separate branches cover runtime patches and startup-memory profiling. The README documents the deployment flow and capabilities; profiling links are limited to the sampled collector/card code, so unsampled stages are not connected speculatively.
